headline: 泰勒絲加碼安可版專輯
context: 泰勒絲宣布推出《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》，加碼四首新歌，本週五正式發行。這是她去年評價兩極的專輯《The Life of a Showgirl》擴充版，有樂評形容新增曲目「有溫暖的一面，也有讓人尷尬的怨念情歌」。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,” featuring four new songs, will release on Friday.
sources.title: Taylor Swift Announces ‘The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,’ Featuring 4 New Songs

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Republic) This four-track addition to a critically maligned album works hard to remind fans what they love about Swift, with some sweet highs and galling lows One downside of turning your release strategies into scavenger hunts and layering clues within your work is that it invites enormous amounts of scrutiny about your potential motive. When Taylor Swift announced an expanded edition of last year’s critically maligned The Life of a Showgirl this week, subtitled The Encore, many fans instantly suspected one of two things: that it was designed to remind Grammy members of Showgirl’s existence during their voting period to determine next year’s nominees, or to oust country ingenue Ella Langley from her record-breaking US No 1 run . If that sounds cynical, it’s also worth remembering that when Swift announced Showgirl last year, she said that unlike her previous album, The Tortured Poets Department – a 16-track record immediately inflated to 31 songs on release day – the purposefully concise, 12-track Showgirl would not be expanded. (This didn’t stop her releasing 34 variants of the record, with various acoustic demos and so on, to juice sales.) Continue reading...

voice_text: 泰勒絲要加碼推出新版專輯了。《The Life of a Showgirl》去年評價兩極，這次她推出擴充版《The Encore》，新增四首歌，本週五正式發行。有樂評形容，新增的曲目有溫暖的一面，也有讓人尷尬的怨念情歌。
